sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.

spells.name: Time Magic: Chrono Stasis
spells.note: Traps enemies in a translucent sphere where time stands still, can catch and return a projectile faster.

spells.name: Time Magic: Time Acceleration
spells.note: He can speed up, slow down, stop or reverse time; a wound from acceleration is hard to heal.

spells.name: Time Magic: Stolen Time
spells.note: The nature of his magic: he steals time from those he targets and keeps it in reserve (thirteen years of it before his death).

spells.name: Time Magic: Time Reversal
spells.note: Reversing time; at the end he spent all his stored time to reverse a kingdom-wide spell.

spells.name: Time Magic: Chrono Stasis Grigora
spells.note: The stronger Chrono Stasis of the repo's book. The name Grigora was not found in the summaries, so this is the mod's page: it is placed with the Mana Zone because the sources say Mana Zone combined with Time Magic ages the flow of mana around him.

spells.name: Time Magic: Chrono Anastasis
spells.note: Greek for time resurrection: the last spell he used before Licht stabbed him; it rewinds time to undo the attack. His signature; the latest in the set.

planned.name: Mana Zone (Time)
planned.note: A Mana Zone ability, not a page: the book already uses the shared Mana Zone gate.

notes: Not in his list (they stay in the basic Time book): Hourglass Step, Borrowed Future, Pendulum Ward, Age Breaker, Moment Reprise and Hourglass Storm are the mod's own 'Julius-inspired' pages (version 0.61) and were not found in any source. No new page, and nothing in TimeBook or the Time VFX was touched (rule 3).
